cases.name: honest-head
cases.says: all three listed witnesses verify and pi and vps alone meet the quorum

cases.name: forged-friend
cases.says: friend is listed but outside the quorum; its matching line does not verify

comment: Serve each checkpoint over served's honest tiles under this directory's trust.cbor. The policy lists pi, vps and friend, but its quorum is 2 of pi and vps alone. Counting is not checking (SPEC 9.1, 10.1).

forged-friend.says: a cosignature line whose name **and** key id match a listed witness does not verify

honest-head.says: MUST parse, and MUST name **exactly** the witnesses `witnesses` lists
